description: Url, Image and Email validation follows PHP safeUrl() and FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL: Url is absolute HTTP(S) only; image paths are relative without ?, #, traversal or a leading slash; percent-encoding must decode away.

Url accepts HTTP with a port
Url accepts an IPv4 host
Url accepts a bracketed IPv6 host
Url rejects a relative path
Url rejects an absolute local path
Url rejects a protocol-relative URL
Url rejects javascript scheme
Url rejects credentials
Url rejects an encoded space

expect.reason: decoded value contains a control character

Url rejects a non-ASCII path
Url rejects an underscore in the host
Url rejects a URL longer than 2048 bytes

Image rejects a fragment in a relative path
Image rejects a leading slash
Image rejects traversal
Image rejects encoded traversal
Image rejects double-encoded traversal
Image rejects a dot segment
Image rejects a colon
Image rejects backslashes
Image rejects a data URL
Image rejects a protocol-relative URL
Email accepts a plain address
